identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Ipatasertib in Combination With Atezolizumab and Paclitaxel as a Treatment for Participants With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Randomized Study of Ipatasertib in Combination With Atezolizumab and Paclitaxel as a Treatment for Patients With Locally Advanced Unresectable or Metastatic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer

armGroups.label: Cohort 1 Arm A: Ipatasertib + Atezolizumab + Paclitaxel
armGroups.description: TNBC participants with programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) non-positive received a combination of paclitaxel, 80 milligrams per meter square (mg/m\^2), intravenous (IV) infusion on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle and ipatasertib, 400 mg, orally (PO), once daily (QD), from Day 1 to Day 21 of each 28-day cycle and atezolizumab, 840 mg, IV infusion on Day 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle until loss of clinical benefit, unacceptable toxicity, or withdrawal of consent, whichever occurred first.

armGroups.label: Cohort 1 Arm B: Ipatasertib + Placebo + Paclitaxel
armGroups.description: TNBC participants with PD-L1 non-positive received a combination of paclitaxel, 80 mg/m\^2, IV infusion on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle and ipatasertib, 400 mg, PO, QD, from Day 1 to Day 21 of each 28-day cycle and atezolizumab-matching placebo, IV infusion on Day 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle until loss of clinical benefit, unacceptable toxicity, or withdrawal of consent, whichever occurred first.

armGroups.label: Cohort 1 Arm C: Placebo + Placebo + Paclitaxel
armGroups.description: TNBC participants with PD-L1 non-positive received a combination of paclitaxel, 80 mg/m\^2, IV infusion on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle and ipatasertib-matching placebo, PO, QD, from Day 1 to Day 21 of each 28-day cycle and atezolizumab-matching placebo, IV infusion on Day 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle until loss of clinical benefit, unacceptable toxicity, or withdrawal of consent, whichever occurred first.

armGroups.label: Cohort 2 Arm A: Ipatasertib + Atezolizumab + Paclitaxel
armGroups.description: TNBC participants with PD-L1 positive received a combination of paclitaxel, 80 mg/m\^2, IV infusion on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle and ipatasertib, 400 mg, PO, QD, from Day 1 to Day 21 of each 28-day cycle and atezolizumab, 840 mg, IV infusion on Day 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle until loss of clinical benefit, unacceptable toxicity, or withdrawal of consent, whichever occurred first.

armGroups.label: Cohort 2 Arm B: Placebo+ Atezolizumab + Paclitaxel
armGroups.description: TNBC participants with PD-L1 positive received a combination of paclitaxel, 80 mg/m\^2, IV infusion on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle and ipatasertib-matching placebo, PO, QD, from Day 1 to Day 21 of each 28-day cycle and atezolizumab, 840 mg, IV infusion on Day 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle until loss of clinical benefit, unacceptable toxicity, or withdrawal of consent, whichever occurred first.
